packageRules.description: Regenerate Gradle dependency-verification metadata whenever a Maven dependency (AGP, Gradle wrapper, androidx, etc.) changes. Gradle's verification pins SHA-256 hashes of every resolved artifact; without refreshing android/gradle/verification-metadata.xml in the same PR, the TWA build check fails with 'Dependency verification failed'. The 'help' task is cheap and resolves the full runtime classpath so all transitive hashes are recorded.

Pin TypeScript to ^6.0 until Angular supports TS 7. Angular 22 (incl. 22.1.0-next.6) declares peerDependency typescript >=6.0 <6.1; bumping to TS 7 breaks @angular/compiler-cli readConfiguration with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Error'). Revisit when an Angular release widens its typescript peer range to include 7.x.
